Vesting Simulator — Time Vesting + Partner B Milestones

Models 48-month time-based reverse vesting with a 12-month cliff (then monthly vesting). Milestones can be achieved through month 96. Partner B additionally receives milestone-based vesting (total 8% of company equity). Use the sliders to set the month each milestone is achieved; milestones are enforced in order.

Milestones are enforced in order. Moving an earlier milestone later will also push later milestones forward if needed.
Order enforcement mode
Auto-adjust
This simulator always enforces “must be achieved in order.” If you drag Milestone 3 earlier than Milestone 2, Milestone 2 will be pulled back (or Milestone 3 pushed forward) to keep order valid.
